input: Set up parental controls on all the kids' devices

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Parental Controls on Kids' Devices
gold.taskDescription: Configure parental controls across all devices used by the user's children.

questions.title: How many kids are you setting these controls up for?
questions.description: Understand the number of children involved to scope the task correctly.

questions.title: What devices need controls — phones, tablets, computers?
questions.description: Identify the specific types of devices that need to be configured.

questions.title: What operating systems do those devices run?
questions.description: Determine whether devices run iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, or other systems, as setup steps differ.

questions.title: What ages are your children?
questions.description: Age ranges will inform how restrictive the controls should be.

questions.title: What specific behaviors are you most trying to limit?
questions.description: Clarify the primary concern — screen time, adult content, app purchases, social media, etc.

questions.title: Do you want a single app to manage all devices centrally?
questions.description: Determine whether the user prefers a unified parental control platform like Google Family Link or Apple Screen Time.

questions.title: Do the kids share devices or each have their own?
questions.description: Find out whether devices are shared among siblings or individually assigned, which affects profile setup.
